SELECT id,name,code,disabled FROM ( SELECT vw.id,vw.name,vw.code,vw.disabled from virtual_warehouse vw where vw.is_deleted = FALSE
and ((vw.code ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%') or vw.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when vw.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , vw.name,
vw.disabled ) warehouse
